Headline: Closure - Avon House Preparatory School, Essex
Info: Avon House Preparatory School in Woodford Green has announced its immediate permanent closure ahead of the September term due to significant financial pressures, including the introduction of VAT on school fees and rising pension costs.

Headline: Financial - Barnet Hill Academy, London
Info: Barnet Hill Academy, an independent Islamic faith school in West Hendon, will drop its fee-paying model and become a state-funded voluntary aided school from September to meet local demand.

Headline: Closure - Ysgol Llansteffan (State), Carmarthenshire
Info: The High Court has rejected a legal challenge against Carmarthenshire County Council's decision to close Ysgol Llansteffan at the end of August 2026, citing the school's unsustainable viability and disproportionate strain on the education budget.
